title: 第26章 黄雀第27章 人造意
lines: 整个丞相府笼罩在一片诡异的寂静之中。月光如霜，洒在相府的高墙之上，府中没有一点人影
突兀的声音在一处庭院内响起
周雪望着熟悉的房间，自己是被周岐救了吧，她在梦中看到了无尽血海，数不尽的人头在自己挥刀下不断扬起
自己站在尸山血海中，坐落在猩红王座上
“梦么…”
她心中一动，斩仙刀又出现在她手中，跟以往不同，现在的斩仙刀似乎向着红色转变，自己跟斩仙刀的联系更深了一些
“醒了”
望向门外，周岐正站在门口，幽冷的月光洒在他身上，更添了一股出尘之意
周雪站起身来，身上的伤势不知何时尽数恢复如初
“走吧，该去皇城里看最后一场戏了”周雪跟上周岐，眨眼间二人消失在夜色中
皇宫潜龙阁
轩辕枭走在楼阁中的密道里，墙上布满了历代君王的画像，尽头伫立着一座龙首巨鼎，鼎上悬挂一副他自己的画像卷轴
鼎中还燃烧着巨大的龙涎香，他走上前闭眼静立在原地，再睁眼时瞳孔中多出一道金色符文
“父皇，我已经等了太久了…”
突然密道墙上传来一道叩击声，他皱眉走出了密道，一道黑衣出现在他身侧
“禀太子，秋家所有人消失不见，北凌跟季家两家主传来消息，他们的人都联系不上了”说完黑衣退至一旁
“看来，有人在插手…”
就在这时一道青年人影出现在潜龙阁门口，轩辕枭双眼微眯，他这个三弟真是拿这里当自己家了
“皇兄，不知道何时动手”
“出了点意外”
听到轩辕枭的话，轩辕尘心中已然猜到，周岐果然在秋家
“果然不出我所料”
轩辕枭幽冷的目光一闪道:“你似乎知道会出意外？”
轩辕羽这才把所有的来龙去脉说了出来，轩辕枭看着他身上的气息逐渐凝聚，但是下一刻又收了回去
“那便开始吧”
他冷哼一声不语转头看了一眼黑衣人，黑衣连忙点头消失不见，轩辕尘也是转身离开
周岐二人看着无人看守的城门，直接走了进去向皇宫进发，就在他们走到太和殿前，终于看到了几乎占满整个太和殿口的军队
一群群身穿金色战甲的战兵，手持长戟站在广场，还有身穿蓝色战甲跟墨青色战甲的侍卫在不断加入其中
太和殿门口站着四道人影，为首二人正是轩辕枭跟轩辕尘，稍后的一男一女便是北凌家跟季家的家主
content_en:
The entire Prime Minister's Mansion was shrouded in an eerie silence. The moonlight is like frost, shining on the high wall of the Prime Minister's Mansion. There is no one in the mansion.
"Ah!"
突兀的声音在一处庭院内响起
Zhou Xue looked at the familiar room. She must have been saved by Zhou Qi. In her dream, she saw an endless sea of ​​blood, and countless heads kept rising under her sword.
Standing in a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood, sitting on the scarlet throne
"Dream..."
Her heart moved, and the Immortal Killing Sword appeared in her hand again. Different from the past, the Immortal Killing Sword seemed to be turning red, and her connection with the Immortal Killing Sword became deeper.
"Wake up"
Looking out the door, Zhou Qi was standing at the door. The cold moonlight shone on him, adding to the sense of being out of the world.
"Hmm"
Zhou Xue stood up, and she didn’t know when all the injuries on her body would be restored to their original state.
"Let's go, it's time to go to the imperial city to watch the last show." Zhou Xue followed Zhou Qi, and in the blink of an eye the two disappeared into the night.
Imperial Palace Qianlong Pavilion
Xuanyuan Xiao was walking in the secret passage in the pavilion. The walls were covered with portraits of kings from past dynasties. At the end stood a giant cauldron with a dragon head, and a scroll of his own portrait hung on the cauldron.
There was still a huge amount of ambergris burning in the cauldron. He walked forward and closed his eyes and stood there quietly. When he opened his eyes again, there was a golden rune in his pupils.
“父皇，我已经等了太久了…”
Suddenly there was a knocking sound on the wall of the secret passage. He frowned and walked out of the secret passage. A man in black clothes appeared beside him.
"Prince, everyone in the Qiu family has disappeared. News came from the heads of the Beiling and Ji families, and none of them can be contacted." After saying this, the black man stepped aside.
“看来，有人在插手…”
At this moment, a young figure appeared at the door of Qianlong Pavilion. Xuanyuan Xiao narrowed his eyes. His third brother really regarded this place as his home.
“皇兄，不知道何时动手”
“Something happened”
After hearing Xuanyuan Xiao's words, Xuanyuan Chen already guessed that Zhou Qi was indeed in the Qiu family.
“果然不出我所料”
Xuanyuan Xiao's cold eyes flashed: "You seem to know that something unexpected will happen?"
Only then did Xuanyuan Yu tell all the ins and outs. Xuanyuan Xiao watched as the aura on his body gradually condensed, but then he took it back the next moment.
"Then let's get started"
He snorted coldly and turned to look at the man in black. The man in black nodded quickly and disappeared. Xuanyuan Chen also turned around and left.
Zhou Qi and the two looked at the unguarded city gate, walked directly in and headed towards the palace. When they walked to the front of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, they finally saw the army that almost occupied the entire entrance of the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
Groups of soldiers wearing golden battle armor stood in the square holding halberds, and guards wearing blue battle armor and dark blue battle armor continued to join them.
There were four figures standing at the door of the Hall of Supreme Harmony. The first two were Xuanyuan Xiao and Xuanyuan Chen, and the man and woman behind them were the heads of the Beiling family and the Ji family.
